name: onetime
description: One-time links for secrets, encrypted in the browser, deleted on first read

scripts.build: vite build && pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:info
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && node tools/check-dist.mjs && node tools/check-dist.mjs dist-info --profile info && ONETIME_ORIGIN=https://onetime.example pnpm build:selfhost && node tools/check-dist.mjs dist-selfhost && node tools/check-selfhost.mjs
scripts.build:selfhost: ONETIME_SITE=selfhost vite build && ONETIME_SITE=selfhost node tools/build-cli.mjs && node tools/build-server.mjs
